batch_node.name: Computing Core dimension v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Dimension node anchoring the tap.computing dimension.

node.name: tap.computing
node.description: The computing dimension. All entity types and edges from the Computing Core plugin are tagged with tap.computing as their default dimension key, with category values: host (compute environments), runtime (programs and processes), storage (files and volumes), network (interfaces, addresses, ports, connections), protocol (application protocols above transport), and identity (humans who interact with the systems). This plugin provides vendor-neutral primitives that apply across cloud and on-prem environments.

node.name: tap.web
node.description: The web-native dimension. A future-boundary marker: web-native entity types (web_host, web_document) carry tap.web=native alongside their tap.computing stack-layer value. These were added to Computing Core under demo-time scope creep above the plugin's intended vendor-neutral-primitive line; the tap.web marker lets a future web_core plugin lift every web-native type and edge in one shot (MATCH on tap.web) without untangling them from the computing primitives.
